script: Sisyphus was a clever king of Corinth. He cheated death twice with cunning chains. Zeus decided to punish him in Tartarus. Sisyphus pushed a massive granite boulder uphill. The boulder rolled downhill just before the summit. He faced the exhausting task forever.
